en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing two lines of German soldiers in dress uniform standing opposite each other with rifles, apparently during a changing of the guard ceremony in a brick-built barracks courtyard. An officer and a drummer are visible to the left, with other officers in the background near an iron gate and a striped guard post. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German.
